titleText.es: A veces intento imaginarme cómo se vería todo si todo el espectro estuviese comprimido dentro del espectro visible. A veces también intento imaginarme a tu hermana desnuda.
titleText.en: Sometimes I try to imagine what everything would look like if the entire spectrum were compressed into the visible spectrum. Sometimes I also try to imagine your sister naked.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Espectro can mean a continuous range, especially a range of wavelengths or frequencies. In other settings it can also mean a ghost, but that is not the sense taught here.

example.es: La luz ocupa una parte del espectro.
example.en: Light occupies one part of the spectrum.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Absorción names the process of taking in light, energy, liquid, or another substance. The written accent marks the stressed final syllable.

example.es: El material reduce la absorción de calor.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Electromagnético describes something involving linked electric and magnetic effects. Its ending changes to electromagnética with a feminine noun.
An onda is a wave or repeating disturbance. Ondas is the plural and can describe electromagnetic, sound, water, or other waves.

example.es: Las ondas viajan por el agua.
example.en: The waves travel through the water.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Viajan is a present-time form of viajar. It is used with ellos, ellas, or ustedes.
Anteriormente places something at an earlier time. It often introduces a contrast with what is true now.

example.en: Previously, I lived in another city.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Portadas is the completed-action form of portar, “to carry,” changed to match a feminine plural subject. In a passive pattern such as eran portadas, it says that the action was done to those things.

example.es: Las cajas fueron portadas por dos personas.
example.en: The boxes were carried by two people.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: aether; ether (an obsolete proposed medium for light)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: In older physics, scientists proposed a substance called the luminiferous aether through which light would travel. Experiments and relativity made that idea unnecessary; this is different from the chemical substance ether.

example.es: En el siglo XIX, algunos científicos hablaban del éter.
example.en: In the nineteenth century, some scientists spoke about the aether.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Retirado is a completed-action form of retirar. With fue, it says that something was taken out of use in a completed past event.

example.es: El tren fue retirado del servicio.
example.en: The train was taken out of service.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Recortes often means reductions in spending, services, or resources. The singular is recorte.
Presupuesto is a plan for how much money is available and how it will be spent. It can also mean a price estimate or quote in another context.

example.es: El proyecto tiene un presupuesto pequeño.
example.en: The project has a small budget.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: As a color word, naranja commonly stays unchanged for gender: una camisa naranja and un coche naranja.
Amarillo changes its ending to match what it describes: amarillo, amarilla, amarillos, or amarillas.
Verde has the same singular form with masculine and feminine nouns; the plural is verdes.
Azul has the same singular form with masculine and feminine nouns; the plural is azules.
Violeta can name the color or the flower. As a color after a noun, it commonly stays unchanged for gender.
Octarino is the Spanish form used for octarine, the fictional color of magic in Terry Pratchett's Discworld stories. It is not a color in the real visible spectrum.

example.es: El mago describió una luz octarina.
example.en: The wizard described an octarine light.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Otras goes before a feminine plural noun. Spanish normally does not put un or una before otro or otra in this meaning.

example.en: We are looking for other answers.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Anuncio can mean either a commercial advertisement or a public announcement. The surrounding words show which meaning is intended.
Ruidoso comes from ruido, “noise,” and changes its ending to match the noun it describes.
Venta can name the act of selling or a sale transaction. En venta means “for sale.”

example.es: La venta de entradas empieza mañana.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Coche commonly means “car” in Spain. Other Spanish-speaking regions may prefer carro or auto.

example.es: Hay muchos coches en la calle.
example.en: There are many cars in the street.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Visible has the same singular form with masculine and feminine nouns. The plural is visibles.

example.es: La señal es visible desde aquí.
example.en: The sign is visible from here.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Radioafición is the hobby of communicating by radio as a licensed amateur operator. It is written as one word even when a line break divides it in a label.
Radio can mean the broadcast medium, a receiver, or a radio-frequency band. It is normally feminine when it refers to broadcasting: la radio.

example.es: Escucho las noticias en la radio.
example.en: I listen to the news on the radio.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Secreto can be a noun, “a secret,” or an adjective meaning “secret.” Here it labels something that is not publicly disclosed.
A rayo can be a ray or beam of radiation, a lightning bolt, or a sudden streak. The scientific labels here use the radiation sense.

example.en: The rays pass through the material.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Cancerígeno describes something capable of causing cancer. Its ending changes to agree with the noun.
Teléfonos is the plural of teléfono. The written accent keeps the stress on lé.

example.es: Los teléfonos están sobre la mesa.
example.en: The phones are on the table.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Móvil literally describes something that can move. In teléfonos móviles it distinguishes mobile or cell phones from fixed landlines.
Tejón is the animal called a badger. The written accent marks the stressed final syllable.

example.en: A badger came out of the forest.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Ardilla is a feminine noun for a squirrel, so it normally takes la or una.
Asustada describes a feminine singular person or animal that feels fear. Masculine singular is asustado.
Controlan is a present-time form of controlar used with ellos, ellas, or ustedes.
In physics, gravedad is the force that attracts masses. In ordinary speech, the same word can also mean seriousness or severity.

example.es: La gravedad atrae los objetos hacia la Tierra.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Visión can mean the ability to see, what someone sees, or a broader viewpoint. The written accent marks the stressed final syllable.
Calor is masculine in standard Spanish: el calor. It can refer to thermal energy or the feeling of being hot.
Láser is a Spanish noun formed from an international acronym. Its written accent marks the first syllable, and the plural can be láseres.

example.es: El laboratorio usa un láser azul.
example.en: The laboratory uses a blue laser.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Estrella can mean an astronomical star or a famous performer. The surrounding words determine the sense.

example.en: That star is very far away.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Principal identifies the most important or central one. It has the same singular form with masculine and feminine nouns.
Censurado is the completed-action form of censurar and can describe material that authorities have suppressed or hidden.
Patata is the usual word for “potato” in Spain. Papa is common in much of Latin America.

example.es: Añade una patata a la sopa.
example.en: Add a potato to the soup.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Gafas is normally used in the plural for eyeglasses, even when referring to one pair.

example.en: I need my glasses to read.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Teletienda combines tele-, relating to television, with tienda, “shop.” It refers to products sold through television advertisements.

example.es: Compró el aparato en la teletienda.
example.en: She bought the device through television shopping.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Blogorayos humorously fuses blog with rayos, “rays,” as though blogs occupied a band of the electromagnetic spectrum.
Proyecto can mean a planned piece of work or a proposal. Proyectos is the plural.
Siniestro can describe something threatening or disturbing. In insurance language it can instead mean a damaging incident or claim.
In an electrical setting, corriente is the flow of electric charge and can also refer generally to supplied electrical power. Elsewhere corriente can mean “current,” “ordinary,” or a flowing stream.

example.es: Corta la corriente antes de reparar el cable.
example.en: Cut the power before repairing the cable.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Teléfono is stressed on lé, which is why it carries a written accent.
Microondas names microwave radiation. The same unchanged word can also mean a microwave oven, usually el microondas.
Tostadoras is the plural of tostadora, an appliance for toasting bread. The word is printed across two lines in this comic but remains one word.

example.es: Las tostadoras están en la cocina.
example.en: The toasters are in the kitchen.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Oscuridad is the noun related to oscuro, “dark.” It can describe absence of light or figurative obscurity.

example.es: No veo nada en la oscuridad.
example.en: I cannot see anything in the darkness.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Cósmico describes something related to the cosmos or outer space. The ending changes to match the noun.
Gamma is the name of a Greek letter used in the scientific term rayos gamma. In that expression it identifies very high-frequency electromagnetic radiation.
A prefijo is an element placed before a word or unit, such as re- or kilo-. Prefijos is the plural.

example.es: Kilo- y mega- son prefijos comunes.
example.en: Kilo- and mega- are common prefixes.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Griegos describes masculine plural people or things associated with Greece or the Greek language.
Entretenido can describe something that holds attention or is enjoyable. Its ending changes to match the noun.
Peta- is placed before a unit to multiply it by one quadrillion, or 10¹⁵. For example, a petabyte is 10¹⁵ bytes in decimal SI usage.
Exa- is placed before a unit to multiply it by one quintillion, or 10¹⁸.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: zappa-; a deliberately fake metric prefix
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Zappa- is not an SI prefix. The comic substitutes the musician Frank Zappa's surname for zetta-, the real prefix for 10²¹.

example.es: Zappa- no aparece en la lista oficial de prefijos.
example.en: Zappa- does not appear in the official list of prefixes.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Sonoro describes something that produces or relates to sound. Sonoras agrees with the feminine plural noun ondas.

example.es: Las ondas sonoras llegan al micrófono.
example.en: The sound waves reach the microphone.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Sonido can mean sound in general or a particular noise that can be heard.
Audible has the same singular form with masculine and feminine nouns. The plural is audibles.
Ese points to a masculine singular noun that is not presented as right next to the speaker. Feminine singular is esa.

example.en: I do not recognize that sound.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: For sound, agudo means high in pitch, opposed to grave, “low-pitched.” In other contexts it can mean sharp or acute.

example.es: El silbato produce un sonido agudo.
example.en: The whistle produces a high-pitched sound.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Habitación usually means a room, especially a bedroom or hotel room. Habitaciones is the plural.
Vacías agrees with feminine plural nouns. Masculine singular is vacío.
Ola usually means a wave in water, but la ola also names the coordinated crowd movement called “the wave.”

example.es: El público empezó a hacer la ola.
example.en: The crowd started doing the wave.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: A campaña is a coordinated series of actions toward a goal, such as an election, advertising, or fundraising campaign.

example.es: Organizan campañas para ayudar al barrio.
example.en: They organize campaigns to help the neighborhood.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Recaudación is the act or result of collecting money, taxes, donations, or ticket revenue. The written accent marks the stressed final syllable.

example.en: The fundraising will help the hospital.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Cerebral describes something related to the brain. Cerebrales is the plural for either masculine or feminine nouns.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that equipment, a vehicle, or a system is taken out of use?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use retirar followed by the thing, then del servicio. In a passive sentence, use a form of ser plus retirado, retirada, retirados, or retiradas.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Retirar means to remove or withdraw, and del combines de with el before servicio. The person or time changes retirar; if the passive form is used, retirado changes its ending to match the thing removed.

example.en: They took the bus out of service.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: What is the usual Spanish expression for reductions made because less money is available?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use recortes de presupuesto for “budget cuts.”
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Recortes means cuts or reductions, and de presupuesto specifies that the reductions concern the budget. The singular recorte de presupuesto is possible when referring to one cut.

example.es: Los recortes de presupuesto retrasaron la obra.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you name an organized drive to collect money?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use campaña de recaudación for a fundraising campaign or pledge drive.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Campaña names the organized effort, while de recaudación states that its purpose is collecting money. Use campañas in the plural when there is more than one drive.

example.es: La escuela inició una campaña de recaudación.
example.en: The school started a fundraising campaign.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: the complete range of electromagnetic radiation, ordered by wavelength or frequency
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Radio waves, microwaves, visible light, ultraviolet light, X-rays, and gamma rays are different portions of the same spectrum. Shorter wavelength corresponds to higher frequency.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: a spectrum showing which wavelengths a substance absorbs
cardDefinitions.noteEn: When light passes through or reflects from material, particular wavelengths can be removed. The missing or weakened bands form an absorption spectrum and can help identify the material.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: octarine is the fictional eighth color of magic in Terry Pratchett's Discworld
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The arrow outside the real visible colors treats this fantasy color as though it had a physical wavelength beyond violet.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: peta- and exa- are real SI prefixes; zappa- is a fake replacement for zetta-
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The real sequence continues with zetta- for 10²¹. The comic writes zappa- instead as a reference to musician Frank Zappa, turning a scientific scale into a name joke.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: a joke that a portion of the spectrum is hidden under a U.S. surveillance law
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The USA PATRIOT Act expanded government surveillance powers after 2001. The blacked-out band exaggerates secrecy by pretending a law can censor part of nature itself.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: láser principal de la Estrella de la Muerte
cardDefinitions.answerEn: the planet-destroying superlaser from Star Wars
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The Death Star is a fictional space station whose main weapon concentrates energy into a destructive beam. The chart jokingly assigns that beam a precise spectral band.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: visión de calor de Jack Black
cardDefinitions.answerEn: a reference to the unaired comedy pilot Heat Vision and Jack
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Jack Black played an astronaut whose mind expanded in sunlight, and his character rode a talking motorcycle. The tiny motorcycle on the graph distinguishes this reference from Superman's literal heat vision.

Retirado is the passive form used here, and del servicio completes the standard expression for taking something out of use.
Recortes names the reductions, and de presupuesto specifies that they concern available funding.
